Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.motion

Class ChangedPixels

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.motion.ChangedPixels
All Implemented Interfaces:
FindDynamicPixels
@Primary @Component public class ChangedPixels extends Object implements FindDynamicPixels
Primary implementation of FindDynamicPixels that detects pixel changes across a sequence of images to identify motion.

This class analyzes a collection of images to find pixels that have changed between frames, creating masks that distinguish between dynamic (moving) and fixed (stationary) pixels. It uses grayscale conversion and thresholding to efficiently detect changes.

Key features:

  • Detects pixel changes using grayscale conversion and thresholding
  • Generates binary masks for both dynamic and fixed pixels
  • Configurable threshold values for sensitivity adjustment
  • Serves as the primary motion detection implementation

  • Method Details

    • getDynamicPixelMask

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getDynamicPixelMask(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.MatVector matVector)
      Creates a binary mask identifying pixels that change across the image sequence. Uses grayscale conversion and a threshold of 50 to detect significant changes. White pixels (255) in the returned mask indicate dynamic/changing pixels.
      Specified by:
      getDynamicPixelMask in interface FindDynamicPixels
      Parameters:
      matVector - collection of images to analyze for pixel changes
      Returns:
      binary Mat where dynamic pixels are white (255) and static pixels are black (0)

    • getFixedPixelMask

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getFixedPixelMask(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.MatVector matVector)
      Creates a binary mask identifying pixels that remain unchanged across the image sequence. This is the inverse of the dynamic pixel mask. White pixels (255) in the returned mask indicate fixed/stationary pixels.
      Specified by:
      getFixedPixelMask in interface FindDynamicPixels
      Parameters:
      matVector - collection of images to analyze for pixel changes
      Returns:
      binary Mat where fixed pixels are white (255) and dynamic pixels are black (0)
